jobs.title: Assistant or Associate Professor/Clinical Professor for the Bechtel Physician Assistant Program
jobs.description: ANNOUNCMENT OF POSITION VACANCYABOUT THIS POSITIONSummary:Colorado Mesa University invites applications for the position of Assistant or Associate Professor to teach in the Bechtel Physician Assistant Program. This is a full-time, in person tenure or clinical track, 12-month position. Courses may be assigned as in-person, or hybrid. Professional development in the discipline, involvement with advising, and service to the department and profession are expected.ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other related duties may be assigned.Develop and coordinate course design, course delivery, and participate in the evaluation of didactic and clinical curriculum.Participate in the admissions process and the applicant screening process.Teach assigned courses in the PA program.Provide student academic advising and evaluation.Assist in clinical site visits.Participate in ARC-PA accreditation processes and program/university assessment.Complete professional development activities and service to the University and community.Participate in the program's ongoing self-assessment process.Administrative responsibilities as assigned.Salary: $98,000-$100,000Commensurate with education and experience. Excellent health and retirement benefits package: Click here for more information!REQUIRED EDUCATION and EXPERIENCE Minimum Qualifications Required:Physician Assistant with the following: Master's degree from an accredited Physician Assistant program. Current certification by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA). Licensed or eligible for licensure as a Physician Assistant in the State of Colorado.Minimum of two years of clinical experience.Preferred Qualifications:Previous teaching experience.Experience with precepting students.Active in community services and participation/leadership in local, regional, or national Physician Assistant or other medical organizations.An earned academic doctoral degree in an appropriate discipline.Colorado Mesa University is particularly interested in candidates who have experience working with students from diverse backgrounds and who have a demonstrated commitment to improving the levels of access and success for underrepresented students within higher education.How to Apply: Applicants will be asked to complete an online application by creating a profile and then providing personal and demographic information. In addition, please be prepared to upload a:Cover letterResume or CVNames and contact information of three (3) professional referencesCopy of transcripts for all degrees completed (if your transcripts include a social security number or birthdate, please redact that information before uploading the document. Official transcripts will be required upon hire)Primary Contact: Rachel Weinzimmer, rweinzimmer@coloradomesa.eduColorado Mesa University is particularly interested in candidates who have experience working with students from diverse backgrounds and who have a demonstrated commitment to improving the levels of access and success for underrepresented students within higher education.Colorado Mesa University is committed to providing a safe and productive learning and living community. To achieve that goal, we conduct background investigations for all final applicants being considered for employment. Background investigations include reference checks, a criminal history record check, and when appropriate, a financial and/or motor vehicle history. Applicant must be able to verify U.S. employment eligibility. Colorado Mesa University is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to a culturally diverse faculty, staff and student body. Women and minorities are encouraged to apply. Any person with a disability as defined by the ADA Amendments Act of 2008 (ADAAA) may be provided reasonable accommodation upon request to enable the person to complete an employment assessment. To request an accommodation, please contact the CMU Human Resources Office by phone or email. You may be asked to provide additional information, including medical documentation, regarding functional limitations and the type of accommodation needed.

jobs.title: Assistant/Associate/Professor of Physical Therapy
jobs.description: ANNOUNCMENT OF POSITION VACANCYABOUT THIS POSITIONSummary:The Doctor of Physical Therapy (DPT) Program at Colorado Mesa University invites applications for two full-time, 12-month, open-rank tenure-track core faculty positions. Positions are available immediately, however start date is flexible. We are seeking collaborative faculty who are excited to contribute to student success, and advance scholarship within a supportive academic environment. Applicants with expertise in basic sciences or clinical physical therapy practice areas are encouraged to apply.The DPT Program graduated its first class in May (100% graduation rate) with the inaugural cohort achieving a 100% first time pass rate on the April NPTE. The program was also recently accredited by the Commission on Accreditation in Physical Therapy Education (CAPTE).The program admits one cohort annually (24 students), allowing for strong faculty-student engagement and mentorship. The program is located in the St. Mary’s Medical Education Center, an interdisciplinary health sciences facility on the main campus in Grand Junction. The facility houses graduate programs in Occupational Therapy and Physician Assistant Studies, creating robust opportunities for interprofessional education and collaboration. Colorado Mesa University also offers graduate programs in Athletic Training, Nursing, and Social Work, contributing to a growing health sciences community.We are seeking faculty with expertise in one or more of the following areas.Basic Science Faculty- Neuroscience- Histology- Physiology- Human cadaver laboratory instructionClinical Faculty- Pediatrics- Research methods and statistics- Therapeutic modalities- Diagnostic Imaging- Professional practice / PT management- Interprofessional education seminarApplicants with expertise in both domains (e.g. Neuroscience & Pediatrics) or other areas of the DPT curriculum are also encouraged to apply, including:- Cardiopulmonary physical therapy- Differential diagnosis- Therapeutic exercise- Pathology for physical therapyThe program values flexibility in teaching assignments and welcomes applicants whose expertise complements existing faculty strengths.ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other related duties may be assigned.Collaborating with the Program Director and Curriculum Committee to coordinate assigned curricular content and maintain compliance with CAPTE standards.Teaching didactic and laboratory courses within the DPT curriculum.Developing and maintaining a scholarly agenda consistent with university expectations and CAPTE standards.Providing academic advising and mentorship to DPT students.Participating in program, university, and professional service activities.Salary: Assistant rank up to $106,500 and Associate rank up to $118,00Commensurate with education and experience. Excellent health and retirement benefits package: Click here for more information!Minimum Qualifications Required:Terminal academic degree (PhD, EdD, DSc, or related).ABD candidates demonstrating progress toward completion may be considered.DPT candidates with demonstrated research activity may also be considered.Demonstrated content expertise in proposed teaching areas.Evidence of effective teaching or potential for excellence in teaching.Demonstrated or emerging scholarly agenda consistent with Boyer’s model of scholarship.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Ability to prioritize tasks, organize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.Ability to effectively utilize instructional technologies such as Brightspace (D2L), Zoom, and Microsoft Teams.Preferred Qualifications:Eligibility for or current licensure to practice physical therapy in Colorado.Minimum three (3) years of clinical practice experience.Prior university-level teaching experience in a DPT or related program (e.g., PTA).Board or specialty certification (e.g., ABPTS, FAAOMPT) in area of expertise.Active membership in the American Physical Therapy Association and relevant academies.Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The positions will remain open until filled. Priority applications will be reviewed by July 1. How to Apply: Applicants will be asked to complete an online application by creating a profile and then providing personal and demographic information. In addition, please be prepared to upload a:Cover letterResume or CVTeaching philosophyScholarship overviewCopy of transcripts for all degrees completed (if your transcripts include a social security number or birthdate, please redact that information before uploading the document.
